$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: No state or meaning shown by color alone. Checked/indeterminate states shown with checkmarks and dashes. Invalid state communicated via error message text and [invalid] attribute.
Checkbox outlines, check marks, focus rings, and invalid border all clearly visible and distinguishable from background in both light and dark modes.
All visible labels match announced checkbox names: 'Default', 'Checked', 'Indeterminate', 'Subscribe to changelog', 'I agree to the Terms of Service'.
All text is complete and fully readable across all stories. No truncation detected.
All focused screenshots show clear blue focus rings: All Types (on Default), With Description (on checkbox), Invalid (on checkbox despite red border).
